content:
ops-rotation: Heads up — after the midnight firmware roll (bmc v2.14 -> v2.15) we started seeing GPU provisioning failures in eu-west-2. Lots of evictions and nodes reporting bootchain signature mismatch / secure boot toggled.

sasha: ugh. any automatic rollback triggered?

eng-oncall-bot: Deploy 2026-03-20T00:12Z started: bmc-firmware/v2.15 -> target: eu-west-2 racks r14-r18. Canary passed earlier.

ops-rotation: Canary passed for CPU-only racks but we missed mixed-gpu racks in canary set. Logs show: `kernel: Loading kernel: signature verification failed` and `bmc: secureboot state=ENFORCING` on ~6 racks.

joel: Can you paste the exact failing message from the provisioning agent?

ops-rotation: snippet: ```
provisioner: attach-gpu -> allocate: node=r14-05, status=FAIL
provisioner: boot-error: EFI_LOAD_ERROR (secure boot verification failed)
```

marie: That'll cause all running jobs to be evicted by the scheduler — cost and SLA hit. How many GPUs impacted?

ops-rotation: Rough count: 48 GPUs across r14-05..r17-12. Eviction spike ~03:10 UTC, scheduler autoscaler started spinning up replacement capacity in us-west-1 which will cost extra.

sasha: Pause the rest of the rollout immediately. If secureboot flipped we should not push v2.15 further.

joel: Agree — pausing. ops-rotation, please run the rollback runbook for the affected racks. Quick command to force boot policy back to permissive on the BMCs for recovery: ```ipmitool -H $BMC -U admin -P $PASS raw 0x30 0x10 0x01 0x00``` (this toggles boot enforcement on our vendor) — use on r14-05..r17-12 only.

ops-rotation: Running manual remediations now. Will also trigger a safe reboot if node doesn't come back. Doing small batches to avoid mass evictions.

eng-oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20260320-39 "oob bootchain signature mismatch - eu-west-2" assigned to eng-infra.

marie: Also add a routing fallback in the scheduler config so new GPU allocations avoid eu-west-2 until we've validated rollback. We should minimize cross-region spill.

joel: Temporary routing rule to add to runtime policy: ```json
{
  "name": "avoid-eu-west-2-gpu",
  "match": {"resource.gpu_count": ">=1"},
  "action": {"preferred_regions": ["us-west-1","eu-central-1"], "exclude": ["eu-west-2"]}
}
```

ops-rotation: Applied exclude in scheduler at 03:42 UTC. New allocations are routing to eu-central-1. Eviction rate dropped after the first batch rollback.

sasha: We need a postmortem and a patch to the canary selection to include mixed-gpu racks. Also verify vendor bootflag semantics — vendor doc shows a subtle change in 2.15 that flips the default when secboot keys are present.

marie: Cost note — autoscaler spin-up in us-west-1 added ~12 hours of extra spot usage. Finance: estimate additional spend ~$6.4k for emergency capacity. Add to incident notes.

ops-rotation: Rollback complete for the 6 racks at 04:10 UTC. Manual BMC toggle + safe reboot restored bootchain acceptance and nodes rejoined. Scheduler shows 46/48 GPUs back online (two nodes had unrelated nvme errors).

joel: Nice work. Next steps: 1) mark v2.15 rollout paused, 2) add mixed-gpu racks to canary set, 3) vendor escalation for the secureboot semantics, 4) follow-up runbook update.

sasha: I'll own the canary change and vendor escalation. ops-rotation, please attach the BMC logs to the incident (dmesg + secureboot-state dump).

ops-rotation: Uploaded logs to INC-20260320-39 and left the per-rack remediation notes.

marie: Filing the cost spike to billing and linking it to the incident.

eng-oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260320-39 updated: status=mitigated, severity=sev2, postmortem_owner=sasha.

ops-rotation: Closing thread here — monitoring for 24h, will reopen if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
